name: Tenser's Floating Disk

source.note: BR2024 body shows Casting Time: Action without Ritual; ritual set from knowledge of the PHB.

targets.description: an unoccupied space you can see

summary: A floating disk of force that carries up to 500 pounds and follows you.
text: A flat, round disk of force, 3 feet across and 1 inch thick, appears floating 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space you can see within range, and lasts 1 hour. It can carry up to 500 pounds; if more weight is put on it, the spell ends and everything on it falls. The disk stays still while you are within 20 feet of it; if you move farther away, it follows to stay within 20 feet of you. It can travel over uneven ground, stairs and slopes, but it can't cross a change in elevation of 10 feet or more (it can't cross a 10-foot-deep pit, or leave one if created at the bottom). If you get more than 100 feet away from it, the spell ends.
